Better Harness CLI

Repository-local AI delivery harness tools.

Usage:
  better-harness <command> [args]
  better-harness <command> <subcommand> [args]

Commands:
  Audience: maintainer

  Quickstart
    report                   Gather static evidence and hand off to the Better Harness skill for
                             a five-minute readiness report
    doctor                   Run bounded read-only Better Harness runtime and host diagnostics

  Workflows
    harness                  Check Better Harness readiness reports and Canvas outputs
                             subcommands: evidence-bundle, workspace-topology, analyze, checkup,
                             selection-profile, source, source-review, task-loop-report, render,
                             preview-canvas, report-quality, repair-findings, record-fix-output,
                             validate-canvas

  Loop Control
    loop                     Gate loop run levels with the fail-closed readiness contract
                             subcommands: readiness

  Project Evidence
    session-analysis         Collect and normalize Qoder, Codex, Claude, Cursor, Qwen, Copilot,
                             Pi, Kimi, WorkBuddy, and Grok session evidence
    dependency-governance    Detect dependency governance files, automation, audit signals, and
                             stale dependency evidence
    cloc                     Count code, comments, and blank lines

  Agent Assets
    agent-customize          Inspect agent-facing Skills, MCPs, hooks, plugins, settings, and
                             memory surfaces
    plugin                   Inspect, plan, and verify the Better Harness plugin lifecycle
                             without applying changes
                             subcommands: status, plan, verify
    agent-lint               Parse AGENTS.md and local Markdown references for agent-instruction
                             linting
    coding-agent-practices   Inspect coding-agent assets and practice evidence
                             subcommands: asset-baseline, inventory, asset-integrity

  Maintainer Diagnostics
    core-change-watch        Build static project, history, core-path, and diff evidence
                             subcommands: change-drift, core-candidates, diff-impact,
                             evidence-pack, git-history-profile, project-profile,
                             qoder-consistency-schema

Examples:
  better-harness report
  better-harness doctor --platform all --json
  better-harness harness analyze --workspace . --language en --format json
  better-harness harness checkup --phase scan --provider qoder --workspace . --json
  better-harness harness render --findings <input>/findings.json --mode qoder-canvas --out .qoder/better-harness --target . --validate --json
  better-harness harness report-quality --report <run>/report.md
  better-harness harness validate-canvas --canvas <run>/report.canvas.tsx
  better-harness core-change-watch project-profile --json
  better-harness core-change-watch change-drift --json
  better-harness dependency-governance --json --benchmark
  better-harness agent-lint --json
  better-harness commands --json

Discovery:
  commands                 List available commands; add --json for machine-readable inventory
  command describe         Describe one command path; add --json for the command contract
  schema                   Emit the OpenCLI schema as JSON
  --help --audience advanced Include workflow and advanced commands
  --help --audience maintainer Include every registered command

Options:
  -h, --help              Print help
  -V, --version           Print version
